profile.headline: Software Engineer at Osceola County BOCC
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the events services industry. Skilled in SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), Databases, Windows Server, C#/VB.Net and Visual Studio, jQuery/JavaScript/Bootstrap/Telerik frameworks. Strong engineering professional with a Microsoft .NET, A+, Net+, Sec+,DreamWeaver focused in IT from New Horizons Learning Institute.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: C#/VB.Net/DotNetNuke modules for memberships/clubs/event registrations as well as club locator, news article creation generation from events created, PayPal DAL/SDK integration for daily finance reports, C#/VB.Net Web APIs/webservices for memberships/clubs/events verification, queries, updates and additions, MySQL/PHP for our event results website, jQuery/JavaScript/Bootstrap/Telerik on all the previously mentioned coding, SQL Server. as main database where we have all views, functions and stored procedures and handled with parametrized access, T-SQL for updating, maintaining and troubleshooting data/databases/tables/views/functions/stored procedures. Classic ASP for multiple sports participants/clubs/events management/coordination/registration.  Crystal Reports for reporting purposes and moving to SSMS in the near future. In the plans of moving towards MVC/Razor. Wrote in MVC/Razor a Waiting List accessed from an iPad stand, an Employee page to update the Waitling List and an Admin page for managing the customers on the list for a client's AccessCenter office.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Git · REST APIs · .NET Framework

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: FB SDK/ClassicASP/.NET C#,VB,Webservices/XCode/SQL/Javascript/jQuery programmer; Worked on multiple projects, too many to mention in Resume in the above mentioned languages, iPhone app for company.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · iOS · Git · REST APIs · .NET Framework

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Development of multiple projects, one which was a corporate intranet web based application to keep track of projects and workers utilizing ASP, VB Script and Javascript.  The projects would show up in a chart, allowing you to see how much work was being made and how many resources were used in a date range which was also selectable being able to go back in time and see work performed or go in the future and see work outcome.  I also developed a rating system for both intranet and internet websites where customers as well as the company’s staff would rate each others work and it would show average and points grouped by company being rated. Modified company’s intranet address book allowing managers add and edit entries and created category selection via database and not by just text field using Javascript to do selections.  Many companies had categories misspelled and would create duplicate categories and not show up in searches. Modified and repaired bidding construction website’s classified section, as well as adding new sections to website. Maintained workstations and servers at corporate office as well as servers in co-location (Level3.)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Wrote a Risk Management software in VisualBasic to keep records and pictures/scans of customers and accidents, as well as creating communication letters printed from program.  Created both E-Z Rent-A-Car and L&M Car Rental websites and maintained them.  Maintained their existing Unix server as well as windows workstations connecting to the server.  Converted them from dedicated serial connections and Unix based to networked and internet Windows server based.  Installed print servers on workstations in many different locations for server to send print jobs.  Wrote inventory management program using handhelds with scanners and placing barcodes on vehicles.  Built and configured new servers (Application Server and SQL Server) that run  the rental and  reservations system to stand alone servers running the rental software, Rent2000.  Wrote an automated rate management system that would calculate next car type’s rental value depending on availability and formulas.  Modified website to interact via XML with new Rent2000 server.  Maintained workstations and servers at corporate office as well as servers in co-location (Level3.)
